deprecation.message: Package has been replaced by SocketJack with many improvements. I Highly suggest switching.

description: MicroSerializationLibrary is a Tcp Network & Serialization library intended for ease of use.
releaseNotes:
Peer to peer functionality built for faster latency and direct communication between clients on a server.
To start a P2P connection simply connect to the main server then anytime after the TcpClient.OnIdentified Event start a server as shown below.
Dim P2P_Server as TcpServer = Await Application.MW.C.StartP2P(RemotePeer)

RemotePeer being the client you want to connect to your server.
Then, on the Client you would Accept by handling the TcpClient_PeerConnectionRequest Event as shown below.

Dim P2P_Client As MicroSerializationLibrary.Networking.TcpClient = Await C.ConnectP2P(Server, True)

Features also incude TcpClient.Send(PeerIdentification, Object) for easily sending indirectly to the client without having to handle it on the server.
PeerRedirect can be canceled on the server inside the TcpServer.OnReceive Event by settings Args.CancelPeerRedirect to False.

Debug/Console Logging added for all network events besides Send and Receive.

Async TcpClient.Connect() w/ timeout (3 seconds) & Auto Reconnect Option.
